Roles.Name: Analyst
Roles.CyberTronianPerk: Work the Numbers: At the begining of every round of combat after the first, you can spend an energon point, to move a creature in combat up or down one place in initiative order.

Training.RolesSkills: Gain one rank in two of the following skills: Alertness, finesse,infiltration, iniative, science, or Technology

Qualifications.ArmorUpgrades: You are tained in standard Armor Upgrades
Qualifications.Weapons: You are trained in one handed weapons, including weapons tha can be used one or two handed.

Perks.Name: Analyze Target
Perks.Effect: You see the enemy as walking datafiles of valuable information. As a standard action make an alertness skill test against the Willpower or Cleverness of a target you can see. On a successs you learn a valuable piece of infomation of yur choice about them. such as their rank in a specific skill, or a defense score.

Perks.Name: Informed Accuracy
Perks.Effect: To know your enememy is to know their weaknesss. When you attack a creature you've used Analyze Target on this Combat, you gain upshift on the attack equal to the times you've used Analyze Target on them'

Perks.Name: Unsurprising
Perks.Effect: Odds are low that you get caught off guard. If you would be Surprised you can act, but instead treat your speed score as if it were equal to your level(up to your actual speed score)

Perk.Name: Data Analyst
Perk.Effect: At 2nd level gain an Edge on Science and Technology Skill test related to extracting or processing data. such as hacking into an enemy computer. IF the extracting process usally takes 2 rounds or longer it takes you half the time

Perks.Name: Determine Probability
Perks.Effect: At 5th level , once per turn, instead of  using a standard action which requires a skill test, you can use a free action to run a simulation of you using that Standard Action. Roll the skill test as if you were actually attempting the Skill Test. If this simulated action succeeds you can use your standard action to use the results of the simulated test instead of making the skill test. On a failure you can ignore the results and use your standard action differently

Perks.Name: Quick Study
Perks.Effect: At 7th level, using Analyze Target is a move action, or Standard Action.

Perks.Name: Pinpoint
Perks.Effect: At 9th level when you use the aim action, instead of 1 upshift on your shot, you can choose to Ignore one of the targets Armor Upgrades for each Free action you spend Aiming.

Perk.Name: Postmortem Interrogation
Perk.Effect: At 12th Level, once per scene, you can extracted information from a defeated cybertronian. Roll a Science or Technology Skill test against a DIF equal to the targets level or threat level. On a success you can ask the GM a question. The Gm must answer truthfully, but from the defeated cybertronians perspective. You may ask another question for every 5 points you exceed the DIF.

Perk.Name: Target Breakdown
Perk.Effect: At 13th level, you can spend a number of free actions equal to the number of times you've used Analyze Target on a target to give an ally upshift on an attack against the target equal to that number

Perk.Name: Psychoanalyst
Perk.Effect: At 14th level as a standard action  you can roll a Science or Technology Skill Test against the Willpower or Cleverness of a target that can hear you. On a sucess the target suffers the Stun 2 effect

Perk.Name: Just the Facts
Perk.Effect: At 16th level you become immune to Deception Skill Tests from creatures your level or lower, and resistance to Deception Skill Test from creatures higher level than you.

Perk.Name: Swift Study
Perk.Effect: At 18th level using Analyze target is a free action. You can use any number of free actions on Analyze Target on a single turn. but you can only target one creature a turn

Roles.Name: FieldCommander
Roles.CyberTronianPerk: Never Forsaken: Once Per Scene, when an ally no further away from you than your fastest movement in alt mode takes Damage, you can spend an Energon Point to move adjacent to that ally, converting if you need to, and take the Damage instead, even if the attack would not normally penetrate your defenses.

Training.RolesSkills: Gain one rank in two skills from the follwoing: Brawn, Dception, Intimidation, Might, Performance, or Persuasion

Qualifications.ArmorUpgrades: You are trained in limited Armor Upgrades
Qualifications.Weapons: You are trained in ballistic weapons and melee weapons

Perk.Name: Issue Command
Perk.Effect: As a move action you can issue a command, granting allies who follow your command an upshift to a skill test or a +1 to Defense based on certain circumstances. You set the terms and the bonus allies recieve,This bonuse last until the begining of your next turn.

Perk.Name: Prepare for War
Perk.Effect: When you roll for Initative and you are not Suprised, you gain an edge on your Initiative skill test

Name.Effect: At 2nd level, as a Standard Action, you can make a perusuasion Skill Test against a target whoese level is no higher than yours. On a sucess give that target a one word order. As long as the order does not put the target in immediate harm, violate one of their core beliefs, and can be accomplished with a move action, they use their move action to follow the command to the best of their abilty on their next turn.

Perk.Name: Synch Up
Perk.Effect: At 5th level once per turn when an ally attacks and misses a target within your range, you can immediately attack that target, even though it is not yoru turn.

Perk.Name: Stoic
Perk.Effect: At 7th level as a move action, you can stand tall for all to see. You take a penealty to eveasion up to -3 and can't defend with Toughness untill the beginning of your nex turn. Your alies each gain a number of Free actions equal to the penalty you took to your Evasion, on their next turn.

Perk.Name: Battle Scan
Perk.Effect: At 9th level, whe nyou roll Initiative,  you learn the Threat Levels of every enemy that you're aware of in this combat.

Perk.Name: Hardened
Perk.Effect: At 12th level you become trained in restricted  Armor Upgrades, and gain +1 health.

Perk.Name: Let Cool Heads Prevail
Perk.Effect: At 13th level, outside of combat, when you role a Social Skill Test with Specialization, you can score a critical sucecess with the d2

Perk.Name: The First Rule of Solidering
Perk.Effect: At 14th level when you roll for Initiative, you can Issue a Command for free

Perk.Name: Complex Command
Perk.Effect: At 15th level, when you issue a command, you can issue two commands. Each command must have different terms and benefits. Allies that meet both terms recieve both benefits

Perk.Name: Stand Together
Perk.Effect: At 18th level, once per scene, as a Standard action, you can make a DIF15 Persuasion Skill Test. On a success, all allies Repair 1 Damage. This is multipled on a Critical Success or a high degree of success

Levels.Name: Gunner
Levels.CyberTronianPerk: Imprompturret: When you conver from Bot Mode with balsistic weapons in your external hardpoints, you can spend an Energon Point to treat the firearms as intergrated Harpoint weapons in your alt mode for the rest of the scene.

Training.RolesSkills: Gain one Rank in Two from the follwing: Alertness, Initative, Survial or Targeting.

Qualifications.ArmorUpgrades: You are trained in limited Armor upgrades
Qualifications.Weapons: You are trained in projectile weapons and Qualified in standard and limited balistic weapons

Perk.Name: Armament
Perk.Effect: You gain an aditional integrated Weapon Hardpoint

Perk.Name: Pistol Whip
Perk.Effect: When you have a Ballistic Weapon in an External Hardpoint it also counts as a Close Combat Bludgeon. You do not add any benefits you normally gain from attacks with a Ballistic Weapon when you use Close Combat Bludgeon.

Perk.Name: Rapid Reload
Perk.Effect: Reloading Weapons with the Reload trait is a free action for you.

Perk.Name: Coververing Fire
Perk.Effect: At 2nd Level, if you attack and miss, the target of your attack suffers a Snag if they attack on their next turn.

Perk.Name: Nowhere's safe'
Perk.Effect: At 5th Level when you fire at a target in cover you suffer one fewer downshift on the attack.

Perk.Name: Bang Bang
Perk.Effect: At 7th level you can attack twice instead of once when you use the Attack action to attack with a ballistic weapon.

Perk.Name: Worth a Shot
Perk.Effect: At 9th Level, once per scene other than combat, you can use a ballistic weapon as a Standard Kit of a Specialization of your choice, and may use Targeting instead of the normal skill a Skill Test Calls for.

Perk.Name: Scratch Resistant
Perk.Effect: At 12th level, you become trained in Restrictied Armor Upgrades

Perk.Name: Absoutely Nowhere's safe
Perk.Effect: At 13th Level, when you fire at a target in cover, you suffer two fewer downshifts on the attack, down to a maximum of zero downsjifts.

Perk.Name: Worth Another Shot
Perk.Effect: At 14th level you can use Worth a SHot twice per scene or once during combat.

Perk.Name: Hard Target
Perk.Effect: At 16th Level when you take cover attackers targeting you take 3 downshifts instead of two

Perk.Name: Bang Bang Bang
Perk.Effect: At 18th level you can attack 3 times isntead of once when you use the Attack action to attack with a ballistic Weapon

Levels.Name: ModeMaster
Levels.CyberTronianPerk: Full Hybrid: You can spend an Energon Point to partially convert as a Free action. You gain the benefits of both your Bot mode and Alt mode, your choice of either modes size,and your choice of either mode's movment.'

Training.Score: Any two but you can not pick the same twice
Training.RolesSkills: Any two skills but but they must be of the esscane score increases you picked

Qualifications.ArmorUpgrades: You are trained in standard Armor upgrades
Qualifications.Weapons: You are trained in standard weapons

Perk.Name: Custom Frame
Perk.Effect: At 1st level, you can choose a custom array of Essence Ssore Progressions. Designate which Essence Scores(Strength, Speed,Smarts, and Social) is first,second,thrid, and forth priority. Each Essence Score increases based on the progression you assign it. First: O Increase this Essence score at 2nd,5th,9th,14th,18th, and 20th levles/ Second: Increase this essence score at 3rd,7th,11th,15th, and 19th levels. Third: INcrease this Essence score at 4th,8th,13th and 16th levels. Fourth: increase this esssence score at 6th, 12th, adn 17th levles. Once you make this desigination you can not change it. The proiority of your essence scores does not relate to the Essence scores your incread at level one

Perk.Name: Mass Shift
Perk.Effect: Once Per scene as a move action, you can change the composition of your body parts and gain one of the following benefits for the remainder of the scene * + 1 to the Defense of your choice. * Upshift on SKill Test of a Skill of your choice. * Double your Reach. * Gain 1 Temporary Health. YOu can use Masss Shift two times per day at 1st level. You gain additonal uses per day as outlined on the Table: ModeMaster. As you gain levles you can choose from a list of Perks called Hybridizaton, Hybridizations all relate to mass shift uses per day. You regain all of your Mass shift uses after a 6 hour rest

Perk.Name: Quick Change
Perk.Effect: As wtith the General Perk of the same name, slect one conversion sequence (such as alt mode to bot mode, bot mode to alt mode, or one alt mode to another) That sequence requires a Free Action to enact instead of a Standar Action

Perk.Name: Hybridization
Perk.Effect: Varies

Perk.Name: Jack of All Forms
Perk.Effect: At 5th lrvel you can use Mass Shift twice in one scene. Each time takes one of your mass Masss Shift uses for the day. YOu can not benefit form the same choice tiwce. If you have the Hold that SShape Hybridization, you gain the benefits of  only One Mass Shift, but instead of lasting until you mass shift again, at the end of any scene in which you have 2 mass shifts in effect, you choose which one ends

Perk.Name: Quick Change 2
Perk.Effect: At 9th level you gain the benefits of Quick Change again, applied to a different conversion sequence

Perk.Name: Helical Spring
Perk.Effect: At 13th level when you convert to Bot Mode, you can move 10ft as part of the action to Convert, when you Convert to alt Mode, you can Ram without needing to move 10ft first

Perk.Name: Master of All Forms
Perk.Effect: At 16th level, you are not limited in how many times you can use Mass Shift in one scene. Eac time takes one of your uses of Mass Shift for the day, lasting until the end of the scene as usual

Perk.Name: Hybridization
Perk.Effect: Varies

Levels.Name: Scientist
Levels.CyberTronianPerk: Intrafilum: When treating an adjacent Cybertronian you can spend one Energon point to restore 1 health

Training.RolesSkills: Gain one rank in two of the follwing skills: Brawn, Conditioning, Science, or Technology

Qualifications.ArmorUpgrades: You are Trained in limited Armor Upgrades
Qualifications.Weapons: You are trained in electic weapons and explosivies

Perk.Name: Broad Understanding
Perk.Effect: Outside of Combat so long as you have at least one Science Specialization, you roll a Science Skill Test as if you were Specialized, although Skill test outside of your specialization suffer 2 downshifts

Perk.Name: Circuit Breaker
Perk.Effect: You can use the Tecnology skill for attacks with electric weapons

Perk.Name: Energon Battery
Perk.Effect: You store a number of personal Energon Points equal to your highest essence score, not your lowest

Perk.Name: Walk Them through it
Perk.Effect: At 2nd level allies without ranks in Technology or Science can Lend Assitence to you on Technology and Science Skill Tests.

Perk.Name: Thesis
Perk.Effect: At 5th Level, outside of Combat, once per scene, you can use Science in place of another Smarts-based Skill for a Skill TEst, but the Skill Test Takes longer. If the Skill TEst takes less than a full turn, it takes your full turn. Otherwise it takes twice as long as stated

Perk.Name: Agument Power
Perk.Effect: At 7th level, you can give an ally 1 upshift on a skill test as a Free Action. Once per combat, you can give an ally 2 upshift on a SKill TEst as a Free Action.

Perk.Name: Energon Bank
Perk.Effect: At 9th Level, with your permission allies withing 30ft can spend your Energon Points instead of their own to gain the benefits of an ability that uses Energon Points.

Perk.Name: Applied Science
Perk.Effect: At 12th level, once per scene, you can use Broad Understanding and Thesis in Combat.

Perk.Name: Overcharge Engines
Perk.Effect: At 13th level, you can use Technology to go faster, Once per turn make a Technology Skill Test as a Free action. Until the end of your turn, increase your Movements a number of feet equal to your skill Test results, rounded up to the enarest 5. This movement ingores Rough Terrain penalties.

Perk.Name: Flashy
Perk.Effect: At 14h Level, when you sucessfully attack with an Electronic Weapon, you can make a Science Skill Test against the Toughness of the target of your attack. On a success they become Blinded 2.

Perk.Name: Techno Babble
Perk.Effect: At 16th level, you can use Thesis in place of Social-Based Skills as well, you can use Thesis three times per scene outside of combat, or once per combat, and Thesis no longer takes extra time to use.

Perk.Name: Multiplication
Perk.Effect: At 18th Level, double the listed number of uses and all numeric benefits of your Scientist Role Perks. For Example you can use Agument Power Twice per turn to gaive an ally 2 upshift on a Skill Test as a Free action, and Tiwce per combat to give an ally 4 upshift on a Skill Test as a Free action.

Levels.Name: Scout
Levels.CyberTronianPerk: Disappear: As a free action, you can spend an Energon Point to turn invisible until the end of your turn

Training.RolesSkills: Gain one Rank in two of the following: Alertness, Deception, inflitration, Initative, and Streetwise.

Qualifications.ArmorUpgrades: You are trained in limited Armor Upgrades
Qualifications.Weapons: You are trained in  silent weapons

Perk.Name: Ally Awareness
Perk.Effect: If an ally has an ability that effects allies within a certain range, you gain the benefits of that ability as long as you are in 5 times the range of the ability. Additionally, once per scene as a Free Action, you can use the memory of advice an ally once gave you to gain the benefits of Lend Assistance.

Perk.Name: Forward Observation
Perk.Effect: Alertness is both a Smarts and Social Skill for you. When you roll an Alertness Skill Test, and the creatures you're observing aren't aware of you, you can score a critical sucess with your d2.

Perk.Name: Keen Sensors
Perk.Effect: You gain the Accute Sense General perk.

Perk.Name: Mark Target
Perk.Effect: At 2nd level, at the begining of a scene(including combat, designate a creature you see, or a specific individual you expect will be in the scene. You gain 1 upshift on Skill Test related to that creature until the end of the scene.

Perk.Name: Hidden in Plain sight
Perk.Effect: At 5th level you can Hide, even if you do not have cover, darkness, or another effect that limits the vision of observers.

Perk.Name: Hindsight
Perk.Effect: At 7th level, when discussing a pervious scene, you can make a new Alertness Skill Test about it as though you were still there. You gain an Edge on these Skill Tests.

Perk.Name: Mimicry Vocoder
Perk.Effect: At 9th Level you can recreate teh voice of an individual you're head speak. You automatically open locks that require a voice print. When speaking with creatures who can't see you clearly, you automatically deceive them if the yhave only a passing familiarity with the individual you're imitating. YOu gain an Edge on Deception Skill Tests to convince creatures more familiar with the individual you're immitating. If you are disguised as teh individual, you can use this ability to gain an Edge on your Decption Skill Test to determine how convincing your disguise is.

Perk.Name: Resourceful
Perk.Effect: At 12th Level. before rolling for Initiative, choose one of te following benefits, which last untill the end of Combat (where applicable) *Roll Initiative Skill Tests with an Edge *Gain one temporary Health * +10ft to one type of Movement *Act Normally if you would be surprised. *An ally who can hear you gains the benefits of Mark Target for the creature you designated.

Perk.Name: Additional Marks
Perk.Effect: At 13th Level, you can use Mark Target on up to five creatures you see, or two specific individuals.

Perk.Name: New Plan
Perk.Effect: At 14th Level, when you use a Contingency Action, if the triggering action never occurs, you gain an additional Move Action or two additional Free actions on your next turn.

Perk.Name: Extremely Resourcefull
Perk.Effect: At 16th Level, when you use Resourcefull, you gain two benefits instead of one

Perk.Name: Mark Everybot
Perk.Effect: At 18th Level, once per day, you can use Mark Target on every creaure in a scene, even those who enter the scene later.

Levels.Name: Warrior
Levels.CyberTronianPerk: Hardcore: When you take enough damage to be deafeated, you can spend an Energon Point to instead lose a limb but otherwise ignore the effect of the attack. You can use Hardcore as long as you have Energon points and limbs to spare.

Training.RolesSkills: Gain a Rank in two of the following, Alertness,Brawn,Conditioning, Culture, Might or Survial.

Qualifications.ArmorUpgrades: You are trained in Limited and Restricted Armor Upgrades
Qualifications.Weapons: You are trained in all weapons and Qualified in Might Weapons

Perk.Name: Foot Soldier
Perk.Effect: When in Bot mode treat your Speed as if it was 2 higher when calculating how many Free Actions you get on your turn.

Perk.Name: Manifest Melee Weapon
Perk.Effect: As a Free Action, Once per combat, you can create an intergrated Energon Weapon without needing to spend an Energon Point as long as the weapon you create is a Standard Melee weapon. This weapon last until the end of combat, or  until you are defeated.

Perk.Name: Wisdom Through Experience
Perk.Effect: Once per scene, following a combat, when looking for clues or theorizing about enemy plans, you may ask the GM if one of your ideas has merit. The GM must answer truthfully, and provide a Hint as to why they gave that answer.

Perk.Name: Charge
Perk.Effect: If you move at least 10ft from your past position(not just stepping into the next square and back again), and then Attack with a Might weapon immediately after, you gain 1 upshift on the Might Skill Test

Perk.Name: Tough it Out
Perk.Effect: At 5th Level, once per  Combat you can make a Brawn Skill Test to REpair your damage as a Standar action. The DIF is the same as teh Tchnology SKill Test to Repair damage.

Perk.Name: Expanded Arsenal
Perk.Effect: At 7th Level when you Manifest a Melee Weapon, you can create a Limited Melee Weapon

Perk.Name: No Escape
Perk.Effect: At 9th Level, once per round when an enemy moves within the Reach of your melee weapon, you interrupt their movement to immediately attack them.

Perk.Name: Battle Hardened
Perk.Effect: At 12th Level you gain +1 health. Additionally, you gain a Limted or Restricted weapon of your choic as personal gear. You must meet the requirments of the weapon to choose it.

Perk.Name: Extended Attack
Perk.Effect: At 13th Level, as a Move Action, you can double the Reach of a Melee Weapon until the beginning of your next turn.

Perk.Name: How I got these dents
Perk.Effect: At 14th Level you gain 1 upshift on Intimidation Skill Test equal to the amount of damage you currently have

Perk.Name: Instruments of Destruction
Perk.Effect: At 16th Level, when you Manifest a Melee Weapon, you can create a Restricted Melee Weapon

Perk.Name: Solider On
Perk.Effect: At 18th Level, if an attack targetting you scores a Critical Hit, once per Combat you may attempt a Brawn Skill Test against a DIF equal to 10+ the Damage dealt to ignore the attack.
